name: Todo manager
author: Brett
description: Lists with nested groups holding notes, to-dos and tasks (subtasks, checklists, tags, due dates, custom fields per kind), shown as a tree (by lists, kind, status, priority, tag or due date) or a grid, with group actions and Markdown export. Ported from xGallery's developer task manager. Tabable: Patches can show it as a tab of its own.
